mapper.sql: id, tenant_id AS tenantId, rule_code AS ruleCode, severity, identity_id AS identityId, identity_type AS identityType, display_name AS displayName, external_key AS externalKey, summary, status, detected_at AS detectedAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, updated_by AS updatedBy, note
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.seq, i.tenant_id, i.identity_type, i.display_name, i.source, i.status, i.external_key, i.employee_id, i.org_id, i.org_path, i.attributes, i.risk_level, i.owner_identity_id, i.expired_at, i.version, i.created_at, i.updated_at FROM oa_iam.identity i WHERE i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND i.identity_type <> 'USER' AND i.status = 'ACTIVE' AND i.created_at < #{since} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oa_iam.authz_decision_log d WHERE d.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND d.principal_id = i.id AND d.decision = 'ALLOW' AND d.evaluated_at > #{since} ) ORDER BY i.seq LIMIT 200

SELECT i.id, i.seq, i.tenant_id, i.identity_type, i.display_name, i.source, i.status, i.external_key, i.employee_id, i.org_id, i.org_path, i.attributes, i.risk_level, i.owner_identity_id, i.expired_at, i.version, i.created_at, i.updated_at FROM oa_iam.identity i WHERE i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND i.identity_type = 'USER' AND i.status IN ('DISABLED', 'EXPIRED') AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oa_iam.grant_record g WHERE g.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND g.subject_type = 'USER' AND g.subject_id = i.external_key AND g.revoked_at IS NULL AND g.valid_from <= #{now} AND (g.valid_to IS NULL OR g.valid_to > #{now}) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oa_iam.permission_delegation d WHERE d.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND d.status = 'ACTIVE' AND d.valid_from <= #{now} AND d.valid_to > #{now} AND (d.delegator_identity_id = i.id OR d.delegatee_identity_id = i.id) ) ) ORDER BY i.seq LIMIT 200

SELECT i.id, i.seq, i.tenant_id, i.identity_type, i.display_name, i.source, i.status, i.external_key, i.employee_id, i.org_id, i.org_path, i.attributes, i.risk_level, i.owner_identity_id, i.expired_at, i.version, i.created_at, i.updated_at FROM oa_iam.identity i LEFT JOIN oa_iam.identity owner ON owner.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND owner.id = i.owner_identity_id WHERE i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND i.identity_type = 'AGENT' AND i.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'CREATED') AND ( i.owner_identity_id IS NULL OR owner.id IS NULL OR owner.status NOT IN ('ACTIVE', 'CREATED') ) ORDER BY i.seq LIMIT 200
